department: Faculty of Science — Department of Physics (Astrophysics and Fundamental Physics)

deadline.value: Admitted through the Department of Physics MPhil-PhD programme: Main Round and HKPFS deadline is December 1, 2026 (Clearing Round: March 31, 2027).
deadline.quote: CUHK Application Deadlines: 1 December 2026 (Main round) and 31 March 2027 (Clearing round)

gre_subject.value: GRE Subject Test score (Physics, Chemistry, or Mathematics) is optional.
gre_subject.quote: [Optional] Provide Graduate Record Examination (GRE) Subject Test Score

supervisor.value: Potential applicants are encouraged to contact individual Physics/Astrophysics faculty before applying.
supervisor.quote: Before making selections, potential applicants are encouraged to contact the individual professors to find out more about their research, their group and what kind of students they are looking for.

funding.value: Regular students receive HK$19,100 - HK$19,660 per month with no separate application required.
funding.quote: Fee and Financial Support | Regular students: HKD19,100-19,660 per month (separate application is not required)

entry_route.value: Articulated MPhil-PhD programme admits both bachelor's holders (direct to pre-candidacy PhD or MPhil stream) and master's holders.
entry_route.quote: Articulated MPhil-PhD programmes provide a pathway for students with a Bachelor's degree to pursue a PhD. Initially, students are admitted as either MPhil students or pre-candidacy PhD students.

notes: Astrophysics and Fundamental Physics research group in the Department of Physics (cosmology, gravitational waves, high-energy astrophysics, particle physics).
